style_en: Miniature diorama 3D CG render placed in an empty white space. Figures are smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details), told apart by clothing, hairstyle and props. Soft shadows, slightly high camera angle looking down. Mostly white and gray, only the key objects in red. Off the coast of West Africa, 2013.
avoid_en: logos, badges, insignia or emblems of real companies or agencies, names, marks or lettering on ships, vehicles and equipment, readable text or numbers, detailed national flags, blood, dead bodies, faces resembling real people

cook.desc_en: the cook, a slim 29-year-old man figurine with dark brown skin and a smooth featureless face (no eyes, nose or mouth details), very short black hair, wearing a plain white sleeveless undershirt and plain dark gray shorts, barefoot

divers.desc_en: the rescue divers, adult man figurines in plain black commercial diving suits with plain yellow hard diving helmets with a single headlamp and a thin hose, no logos, no badges, no text

cuts.en: The upside-down boat on the dark seabed, a faint beam of helmet light touching the outside of its hull from somewhere out of frame. Plain hull, no markings.

cuts.image_en: In the dark room, the cook sitting up on the floating panels and turning his ear toward the steel wall, listening intently.
cuts.en: In the dark room, the cook sitting up on the floating panels and turning his ear toward the steel wall, listening intently.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、船の鉄の壁の模型。表面に、赤い波紋の形が3つ広がっている
cuts.image_en: A plain steel ship wall panel model in the white space with three red ripple rings spreading across its surface like sound waves. No text.
cuts.en: A plain steel ship wall panel model in the white space with three red ripple rings spreading across its surface like sound waves. No text.

cuts.image: 暗い部屋で、料理人のフィギュアが、小さな金属の部品を握り、鉄の壁をたたいている
cuts.image_en: In the dark room, the cook gripping a small plain metal part and striking the steel wall with it, his whole body straining. Dim light.
cuts.en: In the dark room, the cook gripping a small plain metal part and striking the steel wall with it, his whole body straining. Dim light.

cuts.image: 黒い水の通路の奥に、ヘッドライトの白い光が1つ、ぼんやり近づいてくる
cuts.image_en: Looking down a pitch-black flooded corridor inside the upside-down boat, a single white helmet light glowing faintly far away at the other end. Mysterious, hopeful.
cuts.en: Looking down a pitch-black flooded corridor inside the upside-down boat, a single white helmet light glowing faintly far away at the other end. Mysterious, hopeful.

cuts.image: さかさまの船の中で、ダイバーのフィギュアが、ヘッドライトで小さな部屋の入口を照らしている
cuts.image_en: Inside the upside-down boat, one of the rescue divers shining his helmet light into the doorway of a small dark room. Methodical, quiet.
cuts.en: Inside the upside-down boat, one of the rescue divers shining his helmet light into the doorway of a small dark room. Methodical, quiet.

cuts.image: 暗い部屋の水の中に、料理人のフィギュアがすべりこみ、その先にダイバーのヘッドライトの光が見える
cuts.image_en: In the dark room, the cook slipping off the panels into the black water, and just ahead the helmet light of one of the rescue divers shining through the doorway. Tense moment.
cuts.en: In the dark room, the cook slipping off the panels into the black water, and just ahead the helmet light of one of the rescue divers shining through the doorway. Tense moment.

cuts.image: 暗い水の中で、料理人のフィギュアの手が、ダイバーの腕にそっと触れている。ヘッドライトの光が手を照らす
cuts.image_en: Close view in dark water: the cook's bare hand gently touching the arm of one of the rescue divers, the diver's helmet light illuminating the hand. Shock and hope, dramatic light.
cuts.en: Close view in dark water: the cook's bare hand gently touching the arm of one of the rescue divers, the diver's helmet light illuminating the hand. Shock and hope, dramatic light.

cuts.image: 暗い水の中で、ダイバーのフィギュアが驚いてのけぞっている。ヘルメットの横に小さなカメラ
cuts.image_en: In the dark water, one of the rescue divers jerking backward in surprise, a small plain camera mounted on the side of his helmet. Dramatic helmet light. No text.
cuts.en: In the dark water, one of the rescue divers jerking backward in surprise, a small plain camera mounted on the side of his helmet. Dramatic helmet light. No text.

cuts.image: 作業船の中の小さな部屋の模型。画面を見ていたヘッドセットのフィギュアたちが、身を乗り出している
cuts.image_en: A small control room diorama aboard the support ship, several figurines wearing headsets leaning toward a plain glowing monitor, one with arms raised in surprise. Monitor shows only a blurry dark blue image, no text, no logos.
cuts.en: A small control room diorama aboard the support ship, several figurines wearing headsets leaning toward a plain glowing monitor, one with arms raised in surprise. Monitor shows only a blurry dark blue image, no text, no logos.

cuts.image: さかさまの船の中で、ダイバーのフィギュアが、料理人のフィギュアに白いヘルメットをかぶせている
cuts.image_en: Inside the upside-down boat, one of the rescue divers carefully fitting a plain white diving helmet onto the cook. Gentle, careful. No logos, no text.
cuts.en: Inside the upside-down boat, one of the rescue divers carefully fitting a plain white diving helmet onto the cook. Gentle, careful. No logos, no text.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、同じ大きさの風船の模型が2つ。海の上の風船は大きく、水深30メートルの風船は小さく縮んでいる
cuts.image_en: Two balloon models in the white space: one at a bright surface level is full and round, the other at the bottom of a dark water column is squeezed to a quarter of its size. Simple science diorama, no text.
cuts.en: Two balloon models in the white space: one at a bright surface level is full and round, the other at the bottom of a dark water column is squeezed to a quarter of its size. Simple science diorama, no text.

cuts.image: 人の形の透明な模型の中に、小さな白い粒が、体じゅうに散らばっている
cuts.image_en: A clear transparent human-shaped model in the white space with countless tiny white particles spread evenly throughout its body. Educational, calm. No text.
cuts.en: A clear transparent human-shaped model in the white space with countless tiny white particles spread evenly throughout its body. Educational, calm. No text.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、ふたを開けたばかりの無地のペットボトルから、泡があふれ出ている
cuts.image_en: A plain unlabeled soda bottle in the white space just opened, white foam and bubbles rushing out of the top. No label, no logo, no text.
cuts.en: A plain unlabeled soda bottle in the white space just opened, white foam and bubbles rushing out of the top. No label, no logo, no text.

cuts.image: 人の形の透明な模型の中で、白い粒が大きな赤い泡に変わり始めている
cuts.image_en: The clear transparent human-shaped model, the tiny white particles inside it turning into larger red-tinted bubbles. Warning tone, educational. No blood, no text.
cuts.en: The clear transparent human-shaped model, the tiny white particles inside it turning into larger red-tinted bubbles. Warning tone, educational. No blood, no text.

cuts.image: 海の底で、黄色い丸い潜水鐘の模型の下の入口へ、ダイバーが白いヘルメットの料理人を押し上げている
cuts.image_en: On the dark seabed, one of the rescue divers pushing the cook, now in a plain white helmet, up through the bottom hatch of the round yellow diving bell. Plain, no logos, no text.
cuts.en: On the dark seabed, one of the rescue divers pushing the cook, now in a plain white helmet, up through the bottom hatch of the round yellow diving bell. Plain, no logos, no text.

cuts.image: 作業船の甲板の上で、黄色い潜水鐘の模型が、白い円筒形の部屋につながれている
cuts.image_en: On the deck of the support ship, the round yellow diving bell model docked onto the white cylindrical pressure chamber with small round portholes. Clean, technical. No logos, no text.
cuts.en: On the deck of the support ship, the round yellow diving bell model docked onto the white cylindrical pressure chamber with small round portholes. Clean, technical. No logos, no text.

cuts.image: 円筒形の部屋の中の模型。料理人のフィギュアが毛布をかけて寝台に横になっている。丸い窓から光
cuts.image_en: A cutaway of the white cylindrical pressure chamber: the cook lying on a narrow bunk under a plain gray blanket, soft light through a small round porthole. Calm, slow.
cuts.en: A cutaway of the white cylindrical pressure chamber: the cook lying on a narrow bunk under a plain gray blanket, soft light through a small round porthole. Calm, slow.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、5つの小さな箱が横に並ぶ模型。最初の箱は暗い海の色、最後の箱は明るい空の色
cuts.image_en: Five small blocks in a row in the white space, the first ones colored like dark deep sea water, gradually turning to bright sky blue at the last block. Simple, no numbers, no text.
cuts.en: Five small blocks in a row in the white space, the first ones colored like dark deep sea water, gradually turning to bright sky blue at the last block. Simple, no numbers, no text.

cuts.image: 白い空間の海辺の模型に、白い小さな花束が11個、並べて置かれている
cuts.image_en: A quiet seaside diorama in the white space with eleven small white flower bouquets laid in a neat row on the sand facing the sea. Gray calm light. No people, no text.
cuts.en: A quiet seaside diorama in the white space with eleven small white flower bouquets laid in a neat row on the sand facing the sea. Gray calm light. No people, no text.

cuts.image: 白い空間の小さな寝室の模型。ベッドの下半分が、黒い水に沈みかけていて、料理人のフィギュアが目を覚まして身を起こしている
cuts.image_en: A small bedroom diorama in the white space: a plain bed whose lower half seems to be sinking into black water, the cook sitting up in it, startled awake. Dreamlike, uneasy.
cuts.en: A small bedroom diorama in the white space: a plain bed whose lower half seems to be sinking into black water, the cook sitting up in it, startled awake. Dreamlike, uneasy.

cuts.image: 海辺の模型で、料理人のフィギュアが、海に背を向けて歩いていく
cuts.image_en: A seaside diorama, the cook in plain clothes walking away from the sea with his back to the waves. Quiet, gray.
cuts.en: A seaside diorama, the cook in plain clothes walking away from the sea with his back to the waves. Quiet, gray.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、たくさんの小さなスマホとパソコンの模型が浮かび、どの画面にも暗い青の水中の映像が光っている
cuts.image_en: Many small smartphones and laptops floating in the white space, every screen glowing with the same blurry dark blue underwater image. No text, no logos, no faces.
cuts.en: Many small smartphones and laptops floating in the white space, every screen glowing with the same blurry dark blue underwater image. No text, no logos, no faces.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、潜水の服を着た料理人のフィギュアが、白いヘルメットを抱えて、海の方を向いて立っている
cuts.image_en: the cook standing in the white space wearing a plain black commercial diving suit, holding a plain white diving helmet under his arm, facing the sea with calm resolve. No logos, no text.
cuts.en: the cook standing in the white space wearing a plain black commercial diving suit, holding a plain white diving helmet under his arm, facing the sea with calm resolve. No logos, no text.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、水に浮かぶ1枚の板の模型。その上だけが乾いていて、赤い熱の印が残っている
cuts.image_en: A single flat wooden panel floating on calm water in the white space, its top dry, with a small red warm glow on it. Symbolic, calm. No text.
cuts.en: A single flat wooden panel floating on calm water in the white space, its top dry, with a small red warm glow on it. Symbolic, calm. No text.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、3枚の大きなカードの模型が並ぶ
cuts.image_en: Three large blank cards standing in a row in the white space, each with a simple icon: an upside-down glass, a floating board, a sound wave ring. No text.
cuts.en: Three large blank cards standing in a row in the white space, each with a simple icon: an upside-down glass, a floating board, a sound wave ring. No text.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、真っ暗な部屋の模型の中に、小さな白い光が1つだけ灯っている
cuts.image_en: A small pitch-dark room model in the white space, cut open, with a single tiny warm white light glowing inside it. Hopeful, quiet. No text.
cuts.en: A small pitch-dark room model in the white space, cut open, with a single tiny warm white light glowing inside it. Hopeful, quiet. No text.
